prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1342; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to my situation, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on the main road in Conroe, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I came to a stop.
Q: Did you stop completely before the impact?
A: Yes, I was fully stopped at a light. I'd been sitting there for maybe ten seconds when I felt the hit from behind.
Q: What happened to your vehicle after the impact?
A: My car lurched forward and my head snapped back. The airbags didn't deploy, but the seatbelt locked up hard across my chest.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle and speak with the other driver?
A: I got out, yes. The other driver said they looked away for a second. We exchanged information, and an officer came to the scene.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They diagnosed a back strain, mostly in the lower back, and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. Sitting for long periods is hard, and I get a sharp ache when I bend or lift anything heavier than a grocery bag. I've started physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I've been out for a few days and I'm working reduced hours now. My doctor has given me a note about lifting restrictions.
Q: Do you have any prior injuries to your back?
A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago from a desk job, but nothing that needed a doctor.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want my car repaired and my medical bills looked at fairly. I'm trying to get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
